scenes.name: NO GHOSTS
lines: Calculus once divided by a step, then set it to zero: Berkeley's ghosts of departed quantities.
微积分曾先用步长作除数，再令它为零：贝克莱口中“已死量的幽灵”。
This chapter keeps one formal symbol, eta, whose cube is declared zero.
本章只留一个形式符号 η，并规定它的立方为零。
So every quantity is three rational slots: value, slope, half the bend.
于是每个量都是三格有理数：值、斜率、弯曲的一半。

scenes.name: DIVISION STOPS
lines: Division now stops after two terms, with no limit and no endless series.
除法如今两项之内就终止，不取极限，也不展开无穷级数。
The inverse is one closed form: three fractions, with the first slot as denominator.
逆元只有一个闭式：三个分数，分母是第一格。
Multiply back: one, zero, zero. Lean checks this for every finite, nonzero first slot.
乘回去，读出 1、0、0。只要第一格有限且非零，Lean 就检验它成立。
Compose two jets: slopes multiply, and the bend collects two terms. Lean checks both chain rules.
复合两个射流：斜率相乘，弯曲收进两项。Lean 检验了一阶与二阶链式法则。

scenes.name: STAY ON THE SHELL
lines: On a sphere, a flat tangent step pokes out by eta squared, v squared.
在球面上，平直的切向步会刺出球壳，模方多出 η²‖v‖²。
Pull it back by half of that, and the squared length is exactly one, modulo eta cubed.
向内拉回其中的一半，模 η³ 之后模方恰好为 1。
A real step of one half: flat, five fourths; arc, sixty-five sixty-fourths.
取实际步长 1/2：平直点模方 5/4，圆弧点 65/64。
One substitution reads past value, present slope and future bend: the book's causal model.
代入一次，就读出过去的值、现在的斜率与未来的弯曲：这是本书的因果模型诠释。

scenes.name: THE FIDELITY JET
lines: Now the book's fidelity kernel: one over one plus x squared.
再看全书的保真度核：κ(x) = 1/(1 + x²)。
Put x nought plus eta in; the closed-form inverse gives the exact triple.
代入 x₀ + η，有限闭式逆直接给出精确的三元组。
At x equal to one: one half, minus one half, one quarter. Lean checks that triple.
在 x = 1 处：1/2、−1/2、1/4。Lean 检验了这组三元组。
At zero the bend term is minus one; at two, plus eleven over one hundred twenty-five.
在 0 处二阶项是 −1；在 2 处是 +11/125。

scenes.name: THE SECANT'S DEBT
lines: A secant uses two snapshots a step h apart. Lean checks its exact error, one fraction.
割线用相距 h 的两张快照。Lean 检验了它的精确偏差：一个分数。
At one, with step one quarter, it reads minus eighteen over forty-one: too high by five eighty-seconds.
在 1 处取步长 1/4，割线斜率是 −18/41，比真斜率高出 5/82。
At one half, the error vanishes by accident: the chord straddles an inflection.
在 1/2 处，偏差碰巧为零：弦跨过了拐点。
Yet the chord never sees the bend, minus sixteen over one hundred twenty-five.
可弦始终看不见弯曲项 −16/125。

scenes.name: ONE MINUS TWO ALPHA
lines: Now a finite step on the three-sphere, sampled at weight alpha.
现在在三维球面上走有限的一步，按权重 α 取样。
Lean checks the drift: squared length minus one equals one minus two alpha, times the squared step.
Lean 检验了漂移：模方减 1 等于 (1 − 2α) 乘以步长的模方。
The book's example: the left endpoint flies out to twenty-three ninths; the right sinks to nine twenty-thirds.
书中的例子：左端点外飞到 23/9，右端点内缩到 9/23。
Only alpha one half gives one: Lean checks the midpoint stays on the sphere for any step.
唯有 α = 1/2 得到 1：Lean 检验了中点步对任意步幅都留在球面上。

scenes.name: TWO EQUAL HALVES
lines: The midpoint lands on eleven, eighteen, twelve, six, over twenty-five: a rational unit point.
Reflect the start through it: both half-steps share fidelity one twenty-one over six twenty-five. Lean checks it.
关于中点反射起点：两个半拍的保真度同为 121/625。Lean 检验了这一相等。
Left sums give Itô's integral, midpoint sums Stratonovich's; here the gap is the exact factor one minus two alpha.
左端点求和给出伊藤积分，中点求和给出斯特拉托诺维奇积分；在这里，两者之差就是精确因子 1 − 2α。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Math, chapter seven: three slots, no limit taken.
《OMEGA MATH》第七章：三格有理数，不取一次极限。
